queries: September 29 2026 HBM 8-Hi 12-Hi HBM prices memory report

content.text:
HBM Supply Constraints Persist, 2027 Price Outlook Revised Upward with Blended ASP Forecast to Rise 121% YoY, Says TrendForce: TrendForce revised its 2027 HBM blended-ASP forecast to +121% YoY, citing supply constraints, a growing higher-priced HBM4 mix, and HBM4e ramping in 2H27. It said GPU and ASIC makers were considering lower HBM capacity per device and that 8-Hi was expected to be prioritized for evaluation; it forecast a 10–20% per-Gb price premium for 8-Hi versus 12-Hi. (time=2026-09-29; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
HBM Market Bulletin - Sep. 22, 2026: The public report page, marked last modified 22 September, already summarized a sharply raised 2027 HBM price outlook and said 8-Hi was favored and expected to lead 2027 shipments. This establishes that the directional outlook was publicly summarized before the 29 September release; the page does not expose the underlying report tables. (time=2026-09-22; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).

content.text: DRAM Supply to Remain Tight in 2027, Prompting NVIDIA to Lower HBM Configurations for Rubin Ultra, Says TrendForce: TrendForce said NVIDIA was evaluating Rubin Ultra alternatives including 8-Hi and 12-Hi configurations, with the final specification undetermined; it also said some cloud providers were evaluating lower HBM capacities. It projected 2027 HBM bit shipments up 50–60% YoY, still insufficient to keep pace with demand growth. This makes configuration evaluation and supply tightness prior context, rather than confirmation of final specifications or shipments. (time=2026-08-04; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).

content.text: 集邦：HBM供應持續吃緊，上修2027年價格展望: MoneyDJ’s entry is timestamped 15:25:08 on 29 September (Asia/Taipei) and repeats TrendForce’s 121% blended-ASP forecast and its account of 8-Hi evaluation.
